```{r fig-oat-profile-en, fig.cap="OAT sensitivity analysis: effect of the m parameter on P_horizon. Each line represents a district; panels represent SSP scenarios. The vertical dashed line indicates the baseline scenario (m = 1.00).", fig.height=6, fig.width=10}
# ---- OAT profile plot (English) ----

# İngilizce ilçe etiketleri: mevcut DISTRICT_LABELS'tan yalnızca İstanbul -> Istanbul
DISTRICT_LABELS_EN <- gsub("\u0130stanbul", "Istanbul", DISTRICT_LABELS)

oat_plot_data <- oat_all %>%
  mutate(
    m_numeric = m_values[scenario],
    ssp_label = factor(ssp_label, levels = c("SSP1-2.6", "SSP2-4.5", "SSP5-8.5"))
  ) %>%
  filter(p_ufuk > 0)  # filter zeros for log scale

fig_oat <- ggplot(oat_plot_data,
                  aes(x = m_numeric, y = p_ufuk,
                      colour = district_id,
                      group = district_label)) +
  # Baseline scenario line
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1.0, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5) +
  # Data points and lines
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  # 1% reference line (optional)
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.01, linetype = "dotted",
             colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = 2.05, y = 0.012, label = "1%",
           size = 2.5, colour = "grey50", hjust = 0) +
  # Scales
  scale_y_log10(
    labels = scales::label_log(digits = 2),
    breaks = scales::trans_breaks("log10", function(x) 10^x)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(0.5, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, 2.0),
    labels = c("0.50", "0.80", "1.00", "1.20", "2.00")
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = COL_DISTRICT,
    labels = DISTRICT_LABELS_EN,
    name = NULL
  ) +
  # Panels
  facet_wrap(~ssp_label, ncol = 3) +
  # Labels
  labs(
    x = expression("Mosquito-to-human ratio (" * italic(m) * ")"),
    y = expression(P[horizon] ~ "(log scale)"),
    title = expression("OAT: effect of " * italic(m) * " on cumulative establishment risk"),
    subtitle = "\u03c4 = 30, \u03b3 = 0.20 day\u207b\u00b9. Dashed line: baseline scenario (m = 1.00)"
  ) +
  theme_thesis() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

print(fig_oat)

# Save (_en)
ggsave(
  filename = "fig_oat_m_profile_en.png",
  plot = fig_oat,
  path = DIR_OUTPUT_CROSS,
  width = 10, height = 6,
  dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)
```
